description:
Build and validate MAX deep links. 'share' gives a link, an HTML button and a JS helper that open
    MAX's chat picker with prefilled text — works on any website or AI agent output without owning a bot.
    Payload limits are checked, because MAX silently drops payloads that are too long or have bad characters.

bot_name.description: Bot public name as in max.ru/<name> (start, startapp)
bot_name.title: Bot Name

button_label.description: share: label for the generated HTML button; default depends on lang
button_label.title: Button Label

kind.description: start — open bot with payload; startapp — open mini-app; share — 'send to MAX' link for any site, no bot needed; mention — user mention markup
kind.title: Kind

lang.description: Answer language: 'en' English, 'ru' Russian. Pick the user's language; default ru (or XONTA_MAX_LANG)
lang.title: Lang

text.description: share: text to prefill; mention: display name
text.title: Text
